label: McLean County reviewed trails (owner-private review candidate, not approved)
attribution: Trail data: McLean County GIS Consortium (McGIS) and members, licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Reviewed existing trails only; filtered and normalized by Constitution Trail Mapper. Routes are generated and are not an official county map.

omitted.supplements: If no reviewed OpenStreetMap trail supplement is packaged, no OSM-derived path is included. A package that includes one supplies its own included-source description; public ODbL compliance remains unresolved (docs/web/data-rights.md).
omitted.accessRoads: If no access-road package is included, routes connect only along admitted trail geometry; unverified street connections are never invented. A package with access roads supplies its own included-source description.

blockers: The six Proposed branch geometries (OBJECTIDs 1929, 1952, 2349, 3824, 4275, 4772) are omitted by the owner's narrow first-release scope decision; their redistribution basis is still unresolved and nothing here grants it.

The ODbL classification of a merged OpenStreetMap graph is unresolved for any PUBLIC release: this review candidate INCLUDES 4 reviewed OpenStreetMap paths, 9,313 endpoint-local OpenStreetMap service roads and 3,424 Census TIGER/Line roads, and that inclusion is not a rights determination.
The owner has not approved this source composition (254 existing trails, 4 OpenStreetMap paths, 12,737 access roads) for public release; owner-private review is not publication.
Physical iPhone Safari and Android Chrome acceptance (#41) has not been done.
Hosting and basemap decisions are open (docs/web/hosting-runbook.md); sign-in and sync are deferred by decision, as the first launch is guest-first.
